meta.name: Sourwood Holler
meta.note: Generated by tools/genworld.mjs; safe to hand-edit.

hello.text: Alder. I read the creek by what it leaves on the gravel. That's my place behind me. Come say hello before you let yourself in.

again.text: Water is low. The stones are saying so plainly.

hello.text: Fern. Every useful basket in the holler starts as a wet switch in my yard. That's my place behind me. Come say hello before you let yourself in.

again.text: The willow is soaking. Tomorrow it will listen.

hello.text: Hollis. I reset the ford after every hard rain. That's my place behind me. Come say hello before you let yourself in.

again.text: The crossing is sound enough if you place your feet.

hello.text: Acorn. Sap Boiler, up and down this holler my whole life. That's my roof through the trees.

again.text: Heard an owl at noon. Make of that what you like.

hello.text: Don't get many strangers this deep in the wood. Birch -- Stump Splitter. The path forks; my door doesn't.

again.text: A straight plank is a small miracle.

hello.text: Burl. I work the slope as Bark Peeler. The trees talk, if you stand still long enough to be rude to.

again.text: The holler floor eats hats. Hold onto yours.

hello.text: Easy on the roots there. Cedar, Charcoal Burner. The holler keeps its own hours and so do I.

again.text: Sap's running slow. Cold spring.

hello.text: Chestnut, Trail Blazer. Everything here is uphill from something. You get used to it.

again.text: You can't hurry a woodpile.

hello.text: Well now. Hickory. Been Mast Gatherer since the big oak came down. Come by; the kettle's always on the edge of boiling.

again.text: The ridge fog burns off by ten. Usually.
